calculationFlow: Indian enterprises (top 5,000 by revenue) actively deploying GenAI: ~50% = 2,500 enterprises.
Plus Indian IT services adding AI overlay (TCS, Infosys, Wipro AI revenue): ~₹3,000-5,000 Cr (going to global clients but tracked separately).
Plus Microsoft Copilot, Google Workspace AI seats sold to India: ~₹500-700 Cr.
Total Indian enterprise AI spend (pure AI, excl. IT services overlay): ~₹2,000-2,500 Cr.
